content: Welcome to WikiDoc. We appreciate your visit to WikiDoc, the pioneering and largest wiki platform dedicated exclusively to the field of medicine. WikiDoc serves as an online collaborative community where individuals can contribute to and edit the most extensive free, continuously updated medical textbook in existence. This collaborative process is referred to as Co-creation. All contributions made to WikiDoc are carefully monitored and reviewed by medical professionals who serve as Editors-in-Chief. To participate and contribute, you only need basic knowledge of how to use a word processor. Hundreds of individuals actively contribute to WikiDoc, and you can view their most recent contributions and edits by navigating to the Recent Changes page. Anyone can explore the content on WikiDoc by entering a topic of interest into the search box or by browsing through the available categories. If you wish to add or edit content on the site and receive proper credit for your contributions, you will need to create a username.
